title: Chapter 6894: Sealing Strategy?
content:
Chapter 6894: Sealing Strategy?

Chapter 6894: Sealing Strategy?

They assumed this would be a repeat of Immortal Emperor Min Ren’s invasion. They knew Guardian’s members had incredible dao heart, never wavering regardless of the enemies.

They persevered stubbornly through the epochs. Thus, it was only a matter of time before they tried again. Moreover, they were far stronger now, while Devouring Alliance became weaker.

Guardian had gathered outside, so what were they waiting for? Upon taking a closer look beyond the dark curtains, they saw Guardian’s members building massive sealing barriers.

“Sealing all of Stygian?” Immortals from major worlds became confused.

“These walls are effective but not a permanent solution.” An immortal said.

“Need several celestial immortals, one alone can’t seal a major world.” Another said.

Everyone knew Devouring Alliance had at least two primordial immortals - Gu Chun and Skyshroud.

A permanent seal would require more than just one celestial immortal. Alas, these beings were awfully rare in Heavenrealm.

A similar majestic project had been done during Heaven Pit. Heavenfall and Dusk presided over it.

“Closing the entrances first before beating the dogs?” One immortal said: “After all, they got the whole alliance gathered in there, a truly rare opportunity.”

“What are they doing?” Down in Stygian, Big-foot Immortal had the same question.

“Trying to trap us.” Immortal Devourer’s eyes lit brightly, checking the entire wall.

“So be it, they can’t keep it up forever and will have to attack eventually.” Mirage laughed.

Those who had slumbered didn’t mind this at all since they had no plan of leaving Stygian. The dark power here was rather comfortable for a long hibernation.

“They’ll attack soon, it’s to seal escape paths.” Controller had a bad feeling about this.

“We will see who will be the ones running.” Immortal Devourer uttered coldly.

“It is our chance to wash away the humiliation at Grand Thousand World.” Fire Immortal said murderously.

“That’s right, we have the advantages this time.” Extinguish and last-gen cultivators nodded.

They spoke of the disastrous failure when they had tried to invade Grand Thousand World under Zhao Dachui’s leadership.

Back then, Grand Thousand World was prosperous but didn’t belong to Guardian Alliance. It belonged to an entity known as Grand Thousand Beast.

Zhao Dachui’s plan relied on absolute power and speed, subjugating the immortals there and devouring their world.

It appeared effective at first with numerous victories. However, Empress Hongtian’s forces and Golden World came to the rescue.

The empress, Deepsouth, Immortal Emperor Fei, Origin Heaven Emperor, and many more were ferocious. The immortals from Golden World were just as capable.

Being surrounded on both sides forced Zhao Dachui to retreat. This defeat changed their strategy entirely. Instead of direct invasion, they chose to hide and slumber for the right moment in numerous worlds.

In the aftermath, Grand Thousand Beast - who was on the verge of death - handed his world to Guardian Alliance. They gained incredible resources to build a larger defense around Heaven Desolace.

The immortals from Stygian became restless upon remembering this defeat.

“In my opinion, we can’t let them carry out their plan. We must break the seal before it is formed. Waiting is unwise.” Controller, the strategist, had a different view than everyone else.

“Why? We have an absolute advantage in Stygian.” Immortal Devourer disagreed.
